sglang:cached_tokens.description: Number of cached prompt tokens by source (device/host/storage).

sglang:cuda_graph_passes.description: Total number of forward passes categorized by CUDA graph.

sglang:decode_sum_seq_lens.description: The sum of all sequence lengths in decode.

sglang:e2e_request_latency_seconds.description: Histogram of End-to-end request latency in seconds

sglang:evicted_tokens.description: The number of device KV token slots freed by eviction, regardless of whether the data was backed up to host (see sglang:hicache_backup_tokens_total) or destroyed (see sglang:hicache_dropped_tokens_total).

sglang:eviction_duration_seconds.description: End-to-end time of a device eviction pass in seconds; under --hicache-write-policy write_back this includes the blocking D->H backup (see sglang:hicache_backup_duration_seconds for the copy alone).

sglang:full_token_usage.description: The token usage for full attention layers.

sglang:graph_memory_usage_gb.description: Memory used by captured device graphs in GB.

sglang:hicache_backup_bytes.description: Bytes backed up from GPU to local host DRAM (L2), all pools combined, including draft/sidecar transfers that the token counter excludes. Divided by the rate of hicache_backup_duration_seconds_sum, gives the achieved D->H bandwidth while transferring.

sglang:hicache_backup_duration_seconds.description: Time taken to back up KV cache from GPU to local host DRAM (L2) in seconds, per merged write op. Covers all D->H backups regardless of --hicache-write-policy. Distinct from the host-to-storage (L3) sglang:backuped_tokens_total.

sglang:hicache_backup_tokens.description: The number of tokens backed up from GPU to local host DRAM (L2), by host pool (kv, swa, mamba, ...). Covers all D->H backups regardless of --hicache-write-policy. Distinct from the host-to-storage (L3) sglang:backuped_tokens_total.

sglang:hicache_dropped_tokens.description: The number of logical device KV tokens destroyed without a host backup. The pool label is always kv; reason is host_pressure for write-back failure, or write_through_unbacked_eviction when eager write-through did not complete before eviction.

sglang:hicache_host_total_tokens.description: Total capacity of the host KV cache in tokens.

sglang:hicache_host_used_tokens.description: Number of tokens currently used in the host KV cache.

sglang:http_requests.description: Total number of HTTP requests by endpoint and method

sglang:http_requests_active.description: Number of currently active HTTP requests

sglang:http_responses.description: Total number of HTTP responses by endpoint and status code

sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds.description: Histogram of inter-token latency in seconds.

sglang:is_cuda_graph.description: Whether the batch is using CUDA graph.

sglang:kv_available_tokens.description: Number of free token slots in the KV cache pool.

sglang:kv_cache_memory_usage_gb.description: Memory used by the KV cache pools in GB.

sglang:kv_evictable_tokens.description: Number of evictable (radix-cached) token slots in the KV cache pool.

sglang:kv_used_tokens.description: Number of actively used token slots in the KV cache pool.

sglang:load_back_bytes.description: Bytes loaded back from local host DRAM (L2) to GPU, all pools combined, including draft/sidecar transfers that the token counter excludes. Divided by the rate of load_back_duration_seconds_sum, gives the achieved bandwidth over each merged H2D load operation.

sglang:load_back_duration_seconds.description: GPU-stream span of a merged host-to-device load-back copy loop, including gaps between per-layer I/O submissions but excluding pre-transfer queue and fence waits.

sglang:load_back_tokens.description: The number of tokens loaded back from local host DRAM (L2) to GPU, by host pool (kv, swa, mamba, ...).

sglang:mamba_available_tokens.description: Number of free state slots in the mamba SSM pool (hybrid-SSM only).

sglang:mamba_evictable_tokens.description: Number of evictable (radix-cached) state slots in the mamba SSM pool.

sglang:mamba_usage.description: The token usage for Mamba layers.

sglang:mamba_used_tokens.description: Number of actively used state slots in the mamba SSM pool.

sglang:max_total_num_tokens.description: Maximum total number of tokens in the KV cache pool.

sglang:num_decode_prealloc_queue_reqs.description: The number of requests in the decode prealloc queue.

sglang:num_decode_transfer_queue_reqs.description: The number of requests in the decode transfer queue.

sglang:num_grammar_queue_reqs.description: The number of requests in the grammar waiting queue.

sglang:num_paused_reqs.description: The number of paused requests by async weight sync.

sglang:num_prefill_bootstrap_queue_reqs.description: The number of requests in the prefill bootstrap queue.

sglang:num_prefill_inflight_queue_reqs.description: The number of requests in the prefill inflight queue.

sglang:num_queue_reqs.description: The number of requests in the waiting queue.

sglang:num_unique_running_routing_keys.description: Number of unique routing keys in running batch.

sglang:page_size.description: KV cache page size in tokens.

sglang:pending_prealloc_token_usage.description: The token usage for pending preallocated tokens (not preallocated yet).

sglang:per_stage_req_latency_seconds.description: The latency of each stage of requests.

sglang:prefill_effective_tokens.description: Effective prefill tokens with retracted-request re-counts excluded, updated on each log interval. mode: device_hit, host_hit, storage_hit, input. Windowed prefix cache hit rate = rate(sum of *_hit) / rate(sum of all modes); per-tier rate uses a single *_hit mode in the numerator.

sglang:process_cpu_seconds.description: Total CPU time consumed by this process (user + system)

sglang:queue_time_seconds.description: Histogram of queueing time in seconds.

sglang:realtime_tokens.description: Total number of tokens processed (updated on each log interval). mode: prefill_compute, prefill_cache, decode.

sglang:routing_key_all_req_count.description: Distribution of routing keys by running+waiting request count (gt < count <= le).

sglang:routing_key_running_req_count.description: Distribution of routing keys by running request count (gt < count <= le).

sglang:routing_keys_active.description: Number of unique routing keys with active requests

sglang:scheduler_idle_seconds.description: Total wall time while the scheduler has no runnable or queued work.

sglang:scheduler_process_cpu_seconds.description: Total CPU time consumed by the scheduler process across all threads.

sglang:scheduler_stage_seconds.description: Total scheduler-loop wall time exclusively attributed to each stage.

sglang:spec_accept_length.description: Mean acceptance length of speculative decoding (accepted drafts + bonus token per forward).

sglang:spec_accept_rate.description: Speculative acceptance rate (`accepted drafts / proposed drafts` in batch).

sglang:spec_block_accept_length.description: Mean uncapped full-block accept length per verify step (accept + cap-trimmed drafts; exact only in DSpark cap-accept mode).

sglang:spec_cap_length.description: Mean DSpark confidence-scheduled verify window per verify step, incl the bonus slot (0 when no cap is scheduled).

sglang:spec_num_draft_tokens.description: Currently active speculative_num_draft_tokens (decouples from steps under topk>1).

sglang:spec_verify_calls.description: Number of speculative decoding verification calls.

sglang:startup_available_gpu_memory_gb.description: Available GPU memory in GB at startup.

sglang:startup_cuda_graph_time_seconds.description: CUDA graph capture duration by phase in seconds.

sglang:startup_time_seconds.description: Engine startup duration by phase in seconds.

sglang:swa_available_tokens.description: Number of free token slots in the SWA pool (hybrid-SWA only).

sglang:swa_evictable_tokens.description: Number of evictable (radix-cached) token slots in the SWA pool.

sglang:swa_token_usage.description: The token usage for SWA layers.

sglang:swa_used_tokens.description: Number of actively used token slots in the SWA pool.

sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds.description: Histogram of time to first token in seconds.

sglang:uncached_prompt_tokens_histogram.description: Histogram of uncached (compute) prompt token length.

sglang:weight_memory_usage_gb.description: Memory used by model weights in GB.
